verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a built-in agent for exploring segments and analyzing campaign performance in natural language, an MCP integration that lets AI generate insights like campaign performance comparisons, and AI Decisioning which uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message/channel/timing for each customer — all clear examples of AI-generated insights/suggestions from data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI insight features working in practice, and more detail on how insights are surfaced natively vs. via MCP/agent chat.
